title: Alt Text Check
description: Prevents posting images screen readers can't use by checking each one's alt text for missing text, filenames (IMG_2041.jpg, PXL_…), "image of…" redundancy, copies of the caption and excess length, with per-image status chips, one-tap fixes, a decorative toggle, a words-in-the-image reminder for screenshots, and a post button that jumps to the first problem before posting anyway.
stops: Posted images screen readers can't read
